title: The library that drives its songs
prompt: Implement `Song` (as before: five-play like rule with `isLiked()`) and `Library`: starts empty, `add(Song)` appends, `playAll()` plays every held song once, `likedCount()` returns how many held songs are currently liked. The Library must NOT duplicate play counts — it asks its songs.

tests.name: library aggregation
tests.hint: playAll is a delegation loop; likedCount is an aggregation query over isLiked().
